intent_contract.text: Use the attached portrait as the facial and hair appearance reference for the previously requested blue witch, preserving the Gothic citadel sofa scene, languid expression, supported chin, black cat and pumpkins.

Use the attached portrait as the sole facial appearance reference for the witch, preserving her eye shape and spacing, softly oval face, jaw proportions, nose shape, lip contours, natural skin tone, and long dark wavy hair with its center part. Keep her face recognizable as the same person while changing her expression to the specified languid resting look. An intricately detailed photographic portrait of an adult blue witch resting in a Gothic citadel. She wears a midnight-blue velvet witch gown with cobalt silk insets, fine silver botanical embroidery, fitted long sleeves, and a tall blue pointed hat with a softly bent tip. Her long dark hair falls over her shoulders, framing a languid expression with half-lidded eyes and softly relaxed lips. She sits deep on a carved walnut sofa upholstered in faded sapphire velvet. Her left elbow rests firmly on the padded sofa arm, her left forearm rises naturally, and the heel of her left palm supports her chin, with fingers resting along the side of her jaw. Her head tilts gently into that hand, while her right hand lies loosely on her lap. Her hips and thighs settle into the cushion, and her skirt drapes over bent knees toward the stone floor. A black cat sits on the adjacent cushion, its pointed ears, amber eyes, glossy fur and curled tail distinctly visible beside her gown. Ribbed orange pumpkins with rough curved stems cluster at the foot of the sofa; one carved pumpkin glows softly from within. Behind her, pointed stone arches, slender clustered columns, iron candle stands and a leaded lancet window establish the Gothic citadel interior. Cool window light reveals the pile of the blue velvet and weathered stone, balanced by small amber candle highlights. Photograph the scene from a slightly front-left three-quarter viewpoint, showing the entire supporting forearm and chin contact, the cat, and the pumpkins. Prioritize her sleepy face and credible relaxed pose, then the tactile richness of blue fabric, carved wood, black fur and pumpkin rind.
